notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.notes: Yes it's Christmas eve and I'm hard at work getting King Erik to go live!  I know there are a few quirks here and there and I'm working diligently to get them resolved.  They are not however, show stoppers.  The game plays pretty solid.  I work alone on this game with the help of a talented musician who wrote all the music and most of the sound effects.  I really hope you like this game as it's a labor of love!
